title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Kuruvi
desc: Vitrivel becomes caught in a web of crime and violence when he tracks down a man who holds his father as bonded labour along with many innocent people.

title: Antony
desc: Antony, a ruthless gangster, becomes a guardian to Ann Maria, the daughter of a local thug he killed. As they work on their relationship, a forgotten enemy returns to finish them off.

title: Vijay The Master
desc: Troubled alcoholic teacher JD goes to work at a juvenile reform school. When he realises a dangerous criminal is using students to cover up his crimes, JD sets out to stop him.

title: Echo
desc: Desperation sets in when Prakash's failing marriage is threatened by something otherworldly, prompting him to resort to black magic. He soon uncovers shocking family revelations.

title: Kanguva
desc: A tribal warrior's ancient struggle to save his people mysteriously intertwines with a modern bounty hunter's perilous quest, linking two eras in an epic adventure.
